content.title: Amazon Big Spring Sale 2026 Live Blog: All the Best Deals From Apple, Kindle, Garmin, and More
content.text: Add as a preferred source on Google We may earn a commission from links on this page. Deal pricing and availability subject to change after time of publication. Credit: René Ramos/Lifehacker/alvaro gonzalez, OsakaWayne Studios, DBenitostock/Moment Kativ/E+, kiyanochka/iStock via Getty Images Table of Contents Early deals from Amazon's Big Spring Sale were surprisingly good, and starting today, Wednesday, March 25, the sale is now in full swing. As is the case with other big Amazon sales, I'm going to highlight all best the deals as our team covers them throughout the event. All of our recommended deals have been vetted using price-tracking tools, so you can trust that the sales we're talking about are actually good deals, and not just hype designed to fool you.You can read more details about the spring sale here, like what to expect, how long it'll last, and some tips to make your shopping experience better. You can also just browse what's on sale here on your own. We'll continue highlighting new deals as we find them, but you can scroll through to see earlier deals that may still be active. What do you think so far? LiveAmazon Big Spring Sale 2026 Live Blog: All the Best Deals We've Covered so Far Wed, April 1, 2026 at 5:50pm ET The XReal One Pro are considered the best display glasses from XReal. The resolution, field-of-view, audio quality, and customization options make them second to none, as you can read in our full review. You can get them for $598.98, which is 22% off the regular price of $769.00. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 11:30pm ET Tue, March 31, 2026 at 8:30pm ET This budget foldable under-desk walking pad is available on Amazon for $99.98, down from $129.99. You can walk at a steady pace while watching TV or taking a call, then fold the handlebar down and store it either upright against the wall or under your bed or couch. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 7:30pm ET Upgrade how you play classic games with retro-style controllers. If you're emulating on your PC or phone, the 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth Controller is a great retro-feeling controller with modern "Hall Effect" tech so the sticks never drift. Get it for $53.19 (originally $69.99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 6:30pm ET This Victrola Century 6-in-1 Music Center looks like it's straight from the Mad Men era, but it features VinylStream tech so you can beam your records to Bluetooth devices. It also has built-in speakers if you don't want Bluetooth anything. You can get it for $129.99 (originally $199.99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 5:45pm ET This Marshall Acton III Bluetooth Speaker is a modern, high-quality speaker housed in a cabinet patterned after the famous Marshall Stack amplifier. Bonus: It's made of 70% recycled plastic and only vegan materials. You can get it for $199.99 (originally $299.99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 5:15pm ET These Koss Porta Pro Limited Edition open-back headphones look like they time-traveled from 1984, because they basically did. The tech is way better than it was back then, but the design is exactly the same. So cool-looking. At $49.99, they're $10 off. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 4:45pm ET If you want a digital camera that makes a statement, check out the CHUZHAO Digital TLR Camera. It looks like a twin-lens reflex camera from the 1940s, when you shot from the waist. It doesn't use film, though: It's a 12MP digital camera in disguise. It's currently $33.99, down from 39.99. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 4:15pm ET The ASUS ROG Strix XG27UCG does a good job at balancing speed and resolution, and it’s currently down to $299 (originally $449), which is the lowest it has dropped. The idea is simple: use it as a sharp 4K display most of the time, then switch to a faster 1080p mode when you care more about responsiveness. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 3:45pm ET The Nothing Phone (3) has dropped to $599 (originally $799) for the 12GB RAM and 256GB model. That's the lowest price the phone has reached so far. This is Nothing’s most ambitious phone yet (according to this PCMag review), and it shows in how it tries to compete directly with flagship devices while still doing its own thing. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 3:15pm ET Bone conduction headphones are ideal for activities where it is vital to your safety to hear your surroundings, such as when you're running outdoors near a busy road. The original OpenRun headphones are discounted to $89.94 (originally $129.95). If you've never used bone conduction headphones, they're worth a try, and the Shokz Open are a great budget-friendly introduction. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 2:45pm ET Never lose a purse or a suitcase again. If you're an Apple user and don't have any AirTags yet, this is the best time to pull the trigger, with a four-pack currently going for $59.99 (originally $99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 2:15pm ET In my home, I use the Google Nest Thermostat, which looks great and works reliably. You can control your HVAC remotely with the Google app and set automated routines. Right now it's discounted to $89.99 (originally $129.99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 1:45pm ET After my home was broken into, I was on the hunt for a great solar-powered camera that didn't require a subscription. The best one I've found is the Aosu Solar Camera, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for an easy-to-set-up, reliable solar camera with a 360-degree view. You can get it for $59.96 (originally $79.99), an impressive value for the money. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 1:15pm ET The OnePlus Buds 4, the latest earbuds from OnePlus, are down to $79.99 (from $129.99)—that's their lowest price so far. The Buds 4 are positioned as a step up from the Buds 3, borrowing a few ideas from the more expensive Pro series, particularly in how they handle noise cancellation and overall tuning. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 12:45pm ET The Echo Dot Max is Amazon's “Pro” tier smart speaker, designed for people who want better sound quality in a relatively small package at an affordable price. The Echo Dot Max was released last October and is currently at its lowest price ever. You can get one for $74.99 instead of the usual $99.99. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 11:45am ET One of the best budget smartwatches on sale right now is the Amazfit Active 2 Sport, down to $79.99. It’s a fitness watch with a solid feature set, and it will cost you half the price of other brands’ entry-level watches. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 11:11am ET A chest strap is the most accurate way to measure your heart rate during workouts, and today some of the best ones are discounted. That includes the popular and highly rated Polar H10, currently going for $76.99, down from $104.99. This is widely regarded as the best heart rate monitor out there. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 9:08am ET Leaks are no fun. What makes them dangerously expensive is that by the time most homeowners realize there is one, they've already suffered extensive damage that is costly to repair. Luckily, this three-pack of sensors from Aqara works with a companion app that alerts you when they detect a water leak. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 8:30am ET If you're looking for a bigger brand name, you can try the Sony SRS-XB100 Wireless Bluetooth speaker, currently just $33 (originally $59.99). This is a record low price for this speaker. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 7:07am ET I've seen screwdrivers like this all over TikTok, and I'm sure you have too. It won't be able to drill through brick like an impact drill might, but it can make mundane, long tasks much easier and fun, like building furniture or doing simple DIY projects at home. Get the Hoto Electric Screwdriver Kit for $29.99 (originally $59.99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 6:07am ET You never know how important a charger is until you're in need of one. If you're the kind of person who always forgets to bring a portable charger, this keychain that's also a universal device charger with both USB-C and Lightning cables built in is a great solution. Get it for $25.99 (originally $32.99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 5:07am ET Point-and-shoot cameras have been making a comeback. You can get the Camkory Kids Camera for $39.99 (originally $49.99), which shoots 1080p with a 44MP camera lens. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 4:06am ET Nothing's CMF Buds Pro 2 earbuds are just $47 (originally $69), the product's lowest price ever. For under $50, Nothing's earbuds offer better audio quality and features than much pricier competitors. To start, there is a "Smart Dial" on the charging case that lets you control the earbuds. The earbuds have touch controls, but I've never been a fan of those—luckily, by rotating the dial, you can change the volume, pause or play, skip tracks, etc. You can customize the dial to use it as you please. Tue, March 31, 2026 at 3:06am ET The Switchbot Smart Switch Button Pusher is a robot created for a single purpose: to push a button. You can set a routine to push your coffee maker to start at 7:00 a.m. every morning, open or close the garage, turn certain lights on, etc. This Bluetooth version goes for $22.99 (originally $29). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 2:05am ET While you can't take the Amazon Echo Dot outdoors like the previous speakers, you can command it to turn devices on/off, ask it questions, or link multiple Echos together across the house. You can get this newest model for $34.99 (originally $49.99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 1:04am ET Anker has been killing it in the budget speaker and headphone department for some time now. The Anker Soundcore 2 Portable Bluetooth Speaker is a great example, currently $29.99 (originally $44.99). Tue, March 31, 2026 at 12:04am ET The SwitchBot Blind Tilt Motorized Blinds are $48.99 (originally $69.99). They have a solar panel so you don't need to worry about batteries, and you can set up a schedule to open or close your blinds, or program them to turn with the sun to keep the room shady. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 7:00pm ET The 55-inch Samsung S90F OLED has always been a great value option, but right now it's going for $1,097.99 ($500 off the list price of $1,597.99), the lowest price this TV has ever reached. This model is the lowest-priced OLED TV from Samsung's 2025 lineup, and a step below the more premium S95F. For around half the price, the S90F cuts out some features that might not be essential for you anyway: It has lower brightness (though it's still pretty good), no anti-reflective coating, and no connection box (that is, an external input/output hub with HDMI, power, and USB for reducing cable clutter). Mon, March 30, 2026 at 6:00pm ET Mon, March 30, 2026 at 5:30pm ET If you're looking for the latest iPad Air, you can already get the new one at a discount. When the new iPad Air M4 dropped on March 11, Walmart undercut other retailers by offering it for $559—though Amazon has since matched that price. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 5:00pm ET Mon, March 30, 2026 at 4:30pm ET Mon, March 30, 2026 at 4:00pm ET The newest Echo Studio is one of the first that feels like a true smart speaker—offering premium sound and features that can compete with the best smart speakers on the market—rather than just a glorified Amazon accessory. Right now, you can get the second-generation Echo Studio for $189.99 (originally $219.99), its lowest price so far. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 3:30pm ET Mon, March 30, 2026 at 3:00pm ET The JBL PartyBox 520 is the kind of speaker you buy when you have money to spend and want your neighbors to know you have good taste in music. It’s currently $579.95 at Woot, a steep drop from its usual $879.95 price. Price trackers show its previous lowest price was $699.95, so this is the best deal yet. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 2:30pm ET The CooSpo chest strap is a specialist heart monitor, currently going for $26.99 (originally $29.99). It has one job, which is to measure your heart rate, and it does it so well. Lifehacker's Senior Health Editor Beth Skwarecki uses it to get a baseline when she tests other fitness gadgets. If monitoring your heart is a priority, don't sleep on this chest strap. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 2:00pm ET I recently lost my Iniu portable charger on a weekend road trip. Fortunately, it was at the end of my trip, and it had served its purpose well, saving my phone's battery (and therefore my life) multiple times. You can get one now for $19.99 (originally $24.99). Mon, March 30, 2026 at 1:30pm ET If you are looking for earbuds but don't want to pay too much for something you might end up losing, the Soundcore by Anker P20i are a solid pair with some impressive features for their $19.99 price (marked down from $39.99). You get Bluetooth 5.3, 30 hours of battery, water resistance, and a full EQ with its companion app. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 1:00pm ET Amazon's Fire TV Stick 4K Plus is one of Amazon's most popular Fire TV Stick options. It's powerful enough for 4K entertainment, and it's just $25 (down from $49.99) after a 50% discount. The Fire TV Stick Plus offers a quad-core 1.7 GHz processor coupled with 2GB RAM for fast app launches and smooth navigation. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 12:30pm ET The Roku Streaming Stick HD is the most basic Roku Stick you can buy, and it's 40% off right now, making it a great time to upgrade your TV's OS to my favorite one. You can get it for $17.99 (originally $29.99). Mon, March 30, 2026 at 12:00pm ET If you need to make video TV stream and you're on a budget, you won't find many less expensive options than Amazon's Fire TV stick. It's marked down 55% to $17.99. That's less than 20 bucks for HDRO10+ supported 4K streaming. This is the first stick to run Amazon’s new Vega OS, so the response time should be faster than older budget devices, and it has Amazon's new Alexa+AI built in as well. If you're a gamer, it supports Xbox Game Pass and Amazon Luna so you can stream games to your TV without a console. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 11:00am ET The Polar H10 is an incredible chest strap to monitor heart rates, and it's $76.99, down from $104.99. This is widely regarded as the best heart rate monitor out there. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 10:30am ET The Dewalt 20V MAX circular saw is on sale for $99 (normally $159). This tool-only deal gets you a solid saw that’s comfortable to use and ideal for any DIY project. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 10:00am ET This HP EliteBook comes with a 64GB of RAM. That's potentially overkill for most students and workers, but it does mean that this machine is a multitasker's dream. (You'll likely never run out of Chrome tabs.) It is $1,899.98 (originally $2,799) at 32% off its original list price. Mon, March 30, 2026 at 9:25am ET If you're looking for dumbbells, the pair of 55-pound CAP Adjustable Dumbbells are going for $209.99, down from $299.99. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 5:30pm ET The Dewalt 20V Max XR impact driver is a powerful, durable tool that's currently $119.99 (originally $169.99) after a 30% off. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 5:00pm ET If you need a large, thin and light laptop that runs Windows 11, this Copilot+ PC from Samsung, currently $1,199.99 (originally $1,699.99) might suit you. The 16-inch Galaxy Book 5 Pro 360 has an Intel Core 7 Ultra processor with 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage—double that of the MacBook Air above. It also has a touchscreen 3K AMOLED display with a refresh rate of 120Hz. The integrated graphics won't get you far for gaming, but if you need a capable machine for school, work, or personal use, this is a great all-around machine. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 4:31pm ET If you're looking for a rowing machine, the best one we can recommend is the Hydrow Origin Rowing Machine, currently $1,895, down from $2,195. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 4:00pm ET The Original Peloton Bike is $1,295, down from $1,695, and a great opportunity to anyone who has been waiting to jump into one of the most popular exercise bikes. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 3:30pm ET The Bissell Little Green carpet and upholstery cleaner is currently on sale for $74.99 (a 25% off its list price of $99.99). The suction and cleaning power on this machine is strong and it's lightweight and easy to transport. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 3:00pm ET During Amazon's Big Spring Sale, you can pick up the 15-inch M4 MacBook Air for $1,149. That's $150 cheaper than the M5 version. You still get the same 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, and a chip that Apple will likely support for years to come. (The company still supports M1, which came out in 2020.) Fri, March 27, 2026 at 2:30pm ET Craftsman V20 cordless drill/driver kit: Normally $99, this cordless drill/driver is now $69 after a 30% discount—it’s a perfect general-use drill, and comes with a battery and charger so you can use it out of the box. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 2:05pm ET Pixel Watch 3, 41mm, Wifi, $169.99, from a regular price of $249.99, and an original price of $349.99. The Pixel Watch 3 was released in 2024. Check out the full list of the best fitness wearables from the sale here. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 1:30pm ET If you need to trim a tree or clean up fallen branches, a chainsaw can speed up the process. Although most battery-operated chainsaws aren’t quite as powerful as traditional gas-powered ones, a good-quality battery can give you enough power for most things you would use a chainsaw for in your yard. The Greenworks 24-volt, 10-inch chainsaw is on sale for $97.99, down from $149.99. The saw comes with a 24-volt, two-amp-hour battery and a charger as well. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 1:00pm ET If you want a high-quality OLED TV for gaming and movies but the options you’ve been seeing online are out of your price range (they often easily surpass the $1,000 mark), the 55-inch Samsung S85F OLED TV checks most of the necessary boxes and is currently down to $897.99 (originally $1,397.99) thanks to a 36% discount. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 12:30pm ET The Anker Solix F2000 Portable Power Station is down to $799.99 (from $1,999), which is about 60% off and the lowest price tracked so far. At this price, it starts to feel like a realistic backup option for homes, road trips, or anyone who deals with frequent power cuts and wants something more reliable than a basic inverter setup. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 12:00pm ET Fri, March 27, 2026 at 11:30am ET If your wifi is too slow, the bottleneck is probably the router. This TP-Link Archer AXE75 might be the solution, and it's 44% off, bringing it down to $112.99—and it's already a good deal at the full price. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 11:30am ET If you're in the market for a new iPad, consider an "old" iPad instead. Amazon has Apple's cellular M3 iPad Air with AppleCare+ for $718.99 (originally $928) up to 23% off. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 10:26am ET The Roku Smart TV 2026 is a standout pick in this year's Big Spring Sale if you want everything in one package. The 40" version is marked down 44% to just $129. It's an all-in-one, hassle-free streaming solution that's perfect as a second TV in a bedroom or office. It comes with the Roku interface that can be navigated with voice remote, and it offers access to over 500 free live TV channels as well as Netflix, Disney+, and any other pay streamer you can think of. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 8:00am ET The Suunto Vertical is $379 (normally $499), and it's the most premium Suunto smartwatch you can buy at a bargain right now. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 6:00am ET Fitbit Versa 4, $149.95, is down from $199.95. It's one of the best budget Fitbits you can get right now. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 4:00am ET One of the best budget smartwatches on sale right now is the Amazfit’s Active 2 Sport, on sale today for $79.99. It’s a fitness watch with a solid feature set, and it will cost you half the price of other brands’ entry-level watches. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 2:34am ET The Soundcore Rave 3S is a party speaker that uses AI technology to turn any regular song you play over Bluetooth into a karaoke track by digitally removing the vocals. I praised it highly in my recent review, and I've had a lot of fun making it a centerpiece at my parties over the past year. You can pick up one of these guys for $279.99—$70 off the usual price. Fri, March 27, 2026 at 12:00am ET The Enabot EBO ROLA Mini FamilyBot is $128.34 (originally $150.99). It is an adorable little robot-with-a-camera designed to help pet owners to interact with their pets when they're not home. You control it with an app, and it takes surprisingly nice-looking 2K video, even when it's dark. It also transmits and listens to sound, so you can talk to your pet, or press a button to make it meow, bark, or quack. It can also act as a surveillance camera and take pictures or video when something moves in front of it. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 10:15pm ET The fantastic first-generation Bose QuietComfort Ultra earbuds in the Moonstone Blue color are going for $179.99 (originally $299) on Amazon, the lowest price they've ever reached. No brand has reached the standard set by the Bose QuietComfort series. For my money, Bose makes the best ANC gear. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 8:45pm ET One of the best-rated ones on the market is the JBL Boombox 3, which earned a PCMag Editor’s Choice Award—and it's currently 40% off, bringing it down to its lowest price ever of $299.95 (originally $499.95). Thu, March 26, 2026 at 7:15pm ET Thu, March 26, 2026 at 6:45pm ET Garmin Forerunner 265 and 265S, $344.95, originally $449.99 when it first launched in 2023. (It has since been replaced by the Forerunner 570.) Thu, March 26, 2026 at 6:15pm ET Thu, March 26, 2026 at 5:45pm ET If you're looking for over-the-ear headphones that fit neatly into the Apple ecosystem, your best bet might just be the Beats Studio Pro. Right now, they're $159.99 (originally $246.62) up to 35% off—so long as you don't mind the color grey. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 5:15pm ET If you're in the market for a new pair of Beats headphones, especially an on-ear pair of headphones, take a look at the Beats Solo 4. Amazon currently has these discounted by up to 40%, depending on the color, meaning you can pick them up for as low as $119.99. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 4:45pm ET The Google Pixel Watch 4 is the latest model, but that doesn't mean it's too soon to get it at a discount. Right now, the 41mm Wifi Google Pixel Watch 4 is $289.99, down from $350, and the lowest price the basic version of the device has yet reached. All Pixel Watch 4 models deliver faster charging times compared to the Pixel Watch 3, plus satellite SOS, dual-band GPS (for the LTE models), and a new circular display. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 4:15pm ET If you're in the Apple ecosystem and you're looking for a new pair of earbuds, you'd have trouble doing better than AirPods Pro 3. Apple's flagship earbuds sound great, come with interchangeable tips, and sport a number of intelligent, useful features. Amazon currently has the AirPods Pro 3 for $199 (originally $249), a great value for the price. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 3:45pm ET The Garmin Vivoactive 5 originally launched at $299.99 in 2023, but is now at $179.99, give or take a few dollars depending on which color you choose. It has a 42-millimeter body (that’s on the smaller size for smartwatches); a touchscreen for most features but physical buttons to start, stop, and lap workouts; Garmin’s always-excellent workout tracking and analytics; and everyday conveniences like hydration and relaxation reminders, a morning report, weather forecasts, and incident detection. The Vivoactive watches also have a mode for wheelchair users that counts pushes rather than steps, and includes wheelchair and hand-cycling activities. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 3:15pm ET Normally $99.99, this mini massage gun is currently on sale for $78.82. At barely one pound, the Bob and Brad Q2 Mini still packs a lot of punch for its size, in terms of both literal vibrations and overall user experience. The real selling point of this massage gun—which we reviewed in-depth here—is the effectiveness of its heat therapy. Plus, its compact size makes it perfect for travel or bringing to the gym. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 2:45pm ET The Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 are available for $139.95, a 22% discount off their list price of $179.95. As I say in my review, the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 are the best set of BCHs that I have ever tried. They're across-the-board winners: Sound quality, secure fit, and battery life. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 2:15pm ET If you use bigger Milwaukee 18-volt tools like a circular saw, or use a Milwaukee inverter in your emergency kit for temporary emergency power, a few extra six-amp-hour batteries are helpful to have around, but the higher capacity batteries can be expensive. The two-pack of 18-volt Milwaukee six-amp-hour batteries is on sale for $299, 32% off its regular price. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 1:45pm ET Google’s Pixel 10 launched in August 2025 at $799, which already made it a reasonable flagship then, if you liked Google’s software-first approach to Android. Now it’s down to $549 for the 128GB unlocked model—a $250 drop and its lowest price yet. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 1:18pm ET The new Google Pixel Watch 4 came out in summer 2025, and right now, you can get the 41mm Google Pixel Watch 4 for $289.99, down from $350, the lowest price the basic version of the device has reached. Other versions are also discounted right now. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 12:45pm ET The Echo Dot Max is Amazon's “Pro” tier smart speaker, designed for people who want better sound quality in a relatively small package and at an affordable price. The Echo Dot Max was released last October and is currently at its lowest price ever. You can get one for $74.99 instead of the usual $99.99. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 12:15pm ET Amazon's Fire TV Stick 4K Plus is one of Amazon's most popular Fire TV Stick options. It's powerful enough for 4K entertainment, and at $25 for the Amazon Big Spring Sale (down from $49.99). The Fire TV Stick Plus sits above the base Fire TV Stick HD (also discounted right now), and offers a quad-core 1.7 GHz processor coupled with 2GB RAM for fast app launches and smooth navigation. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 11:45am ET Thu, March 26, 2026 at 11:05am ET This Roblox gift card is "worth" $100 in Robux, the online currency used on the gaming platform Roblox, but it's on sale for $80. If you're reading this, chances are good that at some point in the next day/week/month, your child is going to hassle you for Robux anyway, so you might as well pay 20% less. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 9:55am ET Right now, you can get a Cellular Titanium Apple Watch for $449 (originally $749), a great deal so long as you're okay with using last generation's watch. The titanium Apple Watch—the "premium" material, if you will—is the most expensive upgrade outside of the Ultra line. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 8:21am ET If you're a Pixel user, you might find that Google's Pixel Buds Pro are among your best options for earbuds you can find on sale. Right now, the latest model, the Pixel Buds Pro 2, has a solid 26% discount, bringing the price from $229 down to $169. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 6:00am ET The Charge 6 is down to $119.95 (from $159.95) and the Versa 4 is $149.95 (down from $199.95), but the best deal of the bunch is the Inspire 3 at $69.95 (down from $99.95). If you want a simple, minimalist fitness tracker, this is a great way to grab one on the cheap. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 6:00am ET The Kindle Colorsoft came out last summer as the first color Kindle reader, and it's now on sale for $169.99 (originally $249.99). And if you can spare just another $2, you can get the bundle with the clear case, currently going for $171.98 (originally $286.98). This is the biggest discount this device has received since its release. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 4:00am ET If you've been tripping over scattered dumbbells or wasting time hunting for the right weights mid-workout, this deal solves both problems for under $80. Normally $129.99, this home gym storage rack is currently on sale for $79.98. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 2:00am ET Senior Staff Writer, Meredith Dietz, tested the new Hydrow Arc Rowing Machine, and right now it is available for $1,895, a 14% discount off its list price of $2,195. A good workout on a rowing machine can engage up to 86% of your muscles, combining cardio and strength training while being gentle on your joints. Thu, March 26, 2026 at 12:00am ET The best sale you’ll find on a Garmin watch is probably this Forerunner 265, which will run you $344.95 ($449.99). It’s an excellent watch, according to our review. Wed, March 25, 2026 at 10:15pm ET The XP-Pen Magic Note Pad is an LED Android tablet with three screen modes that purport to take it from full color to e-ink mode, transforming it from a notebook to a media player, to an e-reader. Get it for $259.99 (originally $399.99), the lowest price yet. Wed, March 25, 2026 at 8:45pm ET Wed, March 25, 2026 at 7:15pm ET One of the best budget treadmills, the NordicTrack T Series 5, is on sale for $479. That's a 20% markdown from its typical price of $599. Perhaps the coolest part of joining the NordicTrack ecosystem is the access to over 10,000 workouts through iFIT. For $39/month (or $396/year), you can follow expert trainers through global runs, hikes, strength training, yoga sessions, and more, all while the system automatically adjusts your treadmill's speed and incline to match the workout.
